title: Palak's Sketchbook & Art Corner
subtitle: Colored pencil sketches, watercolor doodles, botanical studies and cozy illustrations
artistBio: Drawing has always been my quiet refuge away from screens and syntax. When I sketch, time dissolves into pencil strokes, paper texture, and blended shades of earth, flora, and warmth.

artworks.title: Cozy Thatched Cottage in Blossom Garden
artworks.medium: Colored pencil & light gouache wash on toned tan paper
artworks.story: Drawn on a slow Sunday afternoon while listening to lo-fi beats. I wanted to capture the fairytale warmth of stone chimneys, creeping morning glories, stone pathways, and tiny cottage windows glowing warmly from inside.
details: Delicate stippling on the thatched straw roof

artworks.title: Cute Chibi Character with Little Bunny Companion
artworks.medium: Micron pen lineart with soft watercolor pastel gradients
artworks.story: A whimsical study of soft character expressions and cheerful vibes. Drawn when I needed a quick creative break between debugging sessions. Features a cute braided hairstyle, oversized cozy sweater, and a tiny curious bunny friend.
details: Soft pink blush highlights blended with water brush
Tiny stars and sparkle embellishments around hair

artworks.title: Botanical Wildflowers & Lavender Study
artworks.medium: Graphite pencil and sepia archival ink on textured watercolor paper
artworks.story: Inspired by pressed wild flora collected during walks in Pachmarhi. Each petal, stem, and delicate leaf node was observed and sketched with meticulous attention to natural asymmetry and organic curves.
details: Botanical precision in lavender calyx structure

sketchbookQuotes: “Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.” — Pablo Picasso
“The world is quiet here, between pencil and paper.”
“Code builds systems; art breathes life into thoughts.”
